c: The Seventh Trumpet is a relic found in Eudaimonia Machine. Once collected, it permanently unlocks endless mode in the stage selection menu.
Endless mode disables

Reapers from spawning upon reaching a stage's time limit. Instead, reaching a stage's final minute resets the enemy waves to the beginning, finishing a "cycle". For every cycle, enemies gain +100% of their base HP, their spawn quantity and frequency is increased by +50%, and their damage is increased by +25%. The player's incoming damage cap is also reduced by 1. While endless mode is enabled, the
Merchant will also reappear upon completing a cycle, and sells another Arcana card if inverse mode is also enabled.
